Whether Power Systems' data-center-driven growth (FY2026 guide +14% to +19% revenue at 25%-25.75% EBITDA) keeps expanding fast enough to carry consolidated margin through the 2027 EPA/HELM on-highway transition — because in 2026Q2 consolidated EBITDA was 17.5% vs 18.4% a year ago with Engine (12.5% vs 13.8%), Components (13.2% vs 14.7%) and Distribution (13.6% vs 14.6%) all compressing YoY, so one segment is currently carrying the algorithm.
